findings.statement: Actors 3-6 use Foco/Momentum/Guarda/Furia TP. Of 258 skills, 43 use Spend TP, 25 Gain TP, 46 Cast Time; 20/20 CE keys resolve. Coreto adds TP/cast/bodyguard/block/state/hit/trigger/shop mechanics.
State spans 102 switches, 110 variables, self-switches, actors/party, skills/states/TP and quest/mining data; 8 parallel CEs are switch-owned. Mina maps Coreto services to variables/items.

48 MapInfos, 50 map files and 79 substantive CEs expose 316 CE calls and 1581 plugin commands. 60 CEs contain Battle Core sequences; CE16 has 306 callers. Unlinked CE22 lacks setup/finish/effect; CE132 lacks Action Effect.

plugins.js has 46 active/63 entries, 44 unique, ordered Core→Battle→ATB/TP→Coreto. Duplicate PKD/Coreto_TpEvents entries are drift, but PluginManager deduplicates names. Mina has 33 callers into plugin→TS domain.

SaveCore: 20 local slots; autosave after battle/transfer/menu. Engine persists core game objects. 14 saves mix V[100] and legacy names. Tests unrun; 1.10.0 project vs 1.8.1 runtime and runtime/save need Playtest.

publication_intent: Publish static ownership, integrations, persistence limits and human gates; no runtime-success claim.
